description:
This build order covers the innovative HRE strategy popularized by German pro player Gullyd3ck3l. This guide is based on the comprehensive video analysis by VortiX.
Unlike the traditional HRE meta (Meinwerk into Pro Scouts or naked Fast Castle), this build relies on an Aachen Chapel opening with 6 very fast farms built tightly around it.
Key Features:
- Dark Age Barracks: Early Spearmen production to secure map control or pressure the enemy's gold.
- Feudal Defense: Upgrading Hardened Spearmen and mixing in Men-at-Arms to comfortably hold any Feudal pressure without delaying Castle Age too much.
- Eco Security: Zero reliance on out-of-map resources (Deers/Berries). You transition safely to Castle Age with a booming, fully-protected farm transition right under your Town Center and Chapel influence.
name: Gullyd3ck3l's HRE 1-Barracks 6-Farm Safe Castle (VortiX Showcase)
author: PulpyX

notes: 5x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ go to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. 1x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds a forward @building_military/barracks.webp@ (aggressive) then goes to @resource/resource_food.webp@. @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ is set to @resource/sheep.webp@. The @unit_hre/prelate.webp@ inspires sheep gathering.

When 3x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ gather 14 resources each, pull them: 2 go to @resource/resource_food.webp@, 1 builds a @building_economy/house.webp@. You are left with exactly 20 @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Queue 2x @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and set the @building_military/barracks.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ towards the enemy. The @building_economy/house.webp@ builder goes to @resource/resource_food.webp@ after finishing.

When you have 9x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ (as soon as the 9th pops up), move 4x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. This hits 400 @resource/resource_food.webp@ and 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ simultaneously for aging up. @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ stays on @resource/resource_food.webp@. Build @building_economy/house.webp@ with 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@.

Resources ready for @age/age_2.webp@. Start building the @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@ with 6x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ (place it touching @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and as far back in your base as possible). Pull 2 from @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Leave 3 on @resource/resource_food.webp@, set @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@.

Once you have 6x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ actively gathering @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (excluding the 6 building the landmark), change the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@.

@landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@ completes @age/age_2.webp@. The 6 builders go to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (total 12). Upon getting the 6th @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, shift @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Move @unit_hre/prelate.webp@ into the @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@. In the @building_military/barracks.webp@ upgrade @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, queue @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@, and start placing 6x @building_economy/farm.webp@ safely around the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ under the chapel's influence.

After finishing the 6 @building_economy/farm.webp@ and gathering 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ again, send 2x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build an @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on your @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Leave exactly 3 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and 5 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ permanently. The outpost builders and future @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ go to @resource/resource_food.webp@.

When you reach around 10x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@ (plus the 6 on @building_economy/farm.webp@ = ~16 total on @resource/resource_food.webp@), change @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Preparing economy to hit @age/age_3.webp@.

Click up to @age/age_3.webp@. Pull 10x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to construct your Age III Landmark, typically @landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@. While aging up, keep your @building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to prepare for military production transitions.

Reach @age/age_3.webp@. Landmark finishes and the 10 builders are reassigned. Reallocate your economy to the optimal setup: 13 on @resource/resource_food.webp@, 10 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, and the rest (~10) to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Instantly pull your @unit_hre/prelate.webp@ out of the chapel briefly to secure map relics before the opponent contests them.
